title: CSLM Acquisition Corp. (SPWR) Stock Sinks As Market Gains: What You Should Know

summary: In the closing of the recent trading day, CSLM Acquisition Corp. (SPWR) stood at $0.63, denoting a -2.76% move from the preceding trading day.

title: Williams Lands $5.34 Billion AI Power Deal With Blackstone-Led Group
title_zh: Williams 与 Blackstone 领导的集团达成 53.4 亿美元的人工智能电力交易
summary: Blackstone-led investors acquire a 49% stake in five Williams power projects supporting rising AI-driven data center demand.
summary_zh: Blackstone 牵头的投资者收购了五个 Williams 电力项目 49% 的股份，以支持不断增长的人工智能驱动的数据中心需求。

title: SpaceX and other mega AI deals are lifting big bank profits. CEOs say more are coming.
title_zh: SpaceX 和其他大型人工智能交易正在提升银行的巨额利润。首席执行官们表示还会有更多。
summary: Wall Street's biggest banks are taking a victory lap this week after a global AI boom fueled one of their strongest quarters in recent years.
summary_zh: 全球人工智能热潮推动了华尔街最大的银行近年来最强劲的季度之一，本周它们将迎来胜利。
